basic_info.description: Breathtaking Bridge to Bridge Views! Rarely available 16th floor unit in a mid-century modern full service luxury building. Perfect home or pied-a-terre in Russian Hill. Spectacular views of Alcatraz, North Bay,and Golden Gate Bridge from both the master bedroom, and living room floor-to-ceiling sliding glass doors and walk out terrace. Beautifully remodeled two bedroom one bath Coop. The second bedroom boasts striking bay bridge and city views. Excellent location walk to Ghirardelli square, Aquatic Park, Shops and fine Restaurants on Chestnut, Polk, and Union Street as well as North Beach. Located in Fontana East amenities include one car parking, extra storage, laundry facilities on each floor, doorman/security service, guest parking, club room, and beautiful Zen garden area with BBQ. Monthly HOA Dues: $2,015 per month includes Water, Electricity, Garbage, Heat, Cable, Doorman, Security, On-Site and Professional Management, Common Area Maintenance, Insurance On Structure, and Reserves.
